name: MEAT GRINDER
source:
Jay's job is simple. Smile and greet customers. Grind the meat. Bag it up. Count down the days until you can see your (married) crush. Repeat.

[From [url=https://msksoft.itch.io/meat-grinder]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰伊的工作再简单不过：微笑迎接顾客，绞碎肉块，装袋打包，默默倒数着下一次见到（已婚）暗恋对象的日子。如此循环往复。

[摘自[url=https://msksoft.itch.io/meat-grinder]itch.io[/url]]
